title: EMOM 10: 5 burpees
creator: Common EMOM template
description: Every minute on the minute for 10 minutes, do 5 burpees and rest for whatever is left of the minute. The classic starter EMOM: the work is fixed, the rest shrinks as you slow down. Scale the reps (3 or 4) rather than the minutes.
